India Rises to 5th in Global Market Cap Amid Asian Sell-off

India has regained its position as the world's fifth-largest stock market by market capitalization. This shift occurred as an AI-driven sell-off impacted markets in Taiwan and South Korea. India and China were noted as markets where top firms experienced a decline in market cap share due to an AI lag.
